description: Post flows - selection screen. Test Run decides simulate vs commit.

dueDateCutoff.title: Payment or Delivery Date
dueDateCutoff.note: Labelled 'Up to and Including Due Date' on screen - the selection cutoff.

postingDate.title: Posting Date in the Document
postingDate.note: TWO inputs share this title: nth 0 is the 'Up to and Incl. Posting Date' selection filter, nth 1 is the Posting Control date that actually stamps the document. Taking .first() posts under today's date while the screen looks right. expectDuplicates is the drift alarm - a third input with this title silently redefines nth 1.

testRun.note: Defaults to ON. Left alone, a 'post' simulates, reports success and writes nothing.
